purpose: Portable preservation of an original typed B1-to-P2 text-plan compatibility scaffold; no production integration or extraction qualification.

existing_P2_checkpoint.head: bf2a6fd567b03e1d25dcb66624e719a0cec109fc
existing_P2_checkpoint.registration: Prototype test-only; not production PDF text support.
existing_P2_checkpoint.dependency: subsetter 0.2.6 with default-features=false remains a separately reviewed dependency; candidate lock resolution and production dependency placement are pending.

endpoints.line_endings: LF; complete raw before prefix retained

new_patch.application_constraint: The patch is based on the 25-case P1 test file, not the current P2 source. Do not replace the current 31-case pdf_tests.rs: preserve its original six-case P2 suffix when appending the new 13 cases, and preserve all 46 existing helper-module cases. No automatic application or registration is supplied.

font_source.head: df3eff1ce9768c1d2cab3ed7cdb91471dd30e95f
font_source.policy: Only the already admitted bundled regular Liberation Sans face 0; no font bytes are included in this packet. Existing attribution and OFL remain applicable.
font_source.B1_identity: SHA256(font bytes followed by little-endian face index); separate from raw resource SHA256.

static_review.kind: Independent source review; not compiler, test, PDF or reader evidence.
static_review.finding_closed_in_source: Exact font-byte envelope is admitted before digest/table work; original twelve cases retained and a thirteenth original refusal case added.
static_review.patch_literal_replay: Both LF endpoints reconstructed by literal unified-hunk replay; no Git operation or execution of Rust code.

remaining_constraints: Single glyph per logical cluster only; multi-glyph clusters explicitly refuse. No repeated full logical text per glyph, silent split, normalization, or unsupported extraction claim.

This compatibility scaffold checks original hmtx provenance and reuses the legacy MetricView font-object helper. It does not implement the final B1-owned intrinsic-width provider or remove the emitter-local parser.
DW/.notdef policy, exact emitted-CID width coverage and remaining legacy validation duties must be settled before final width-provider migration.
Cam owns the many-page parent, collect_layers, content, global object allocator and page-resource integration. No fixed ref/font tag assumptions or shared edits are supplied.
B1a/B1b and PDF snapshots are separate draft branches, not a composed validated source.
No parent registration, production dependency/lock resolution, compiler/formatter/test result, runtime PDF extraction, whole-project gate, readiness or merge is supplied.
authorship: Original adapter and acceptance cases by the Engineer team for 0xlillith; referenced B1 and PDF work retains its existing contributor authorship. No external implementation code or new asset is copied.
